description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the average rate at which a model attends to different input segments – context, generated response, and other – during generation, comparing “Ours” to a “Standard” model. The vertical axis labels the two categories being compared: “Ours” and “Standard”. The horizontal axis represents percentage, scaling from 0% to 100% with tick labels at 0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 100%.  Each bar is segmented and stacked, with blue representing “Context”, orange representing “Generated Response”, and green representing “Other”. For “Ours”, the “Context” segment occupies 60.6% of the bar, “Generated Response” occupies 31.7%, and “Other” occupies 7.7%. For “Standard”, the “Context” segment occupies 23.6%, “Generated Response” occupies 51.1%, and “Other” occupies 25.3%. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized. A legend at the bottom clarifies the color coding for each segment.
